_comment: OpenLane 2.x design config for pushing an EvoHDL genome through the real open SkyWater 130nm (sky130_fd_sc_hd) PDK flow. openlane_runner.py generates a copy of this file per run with DESIGN_NAME / VERILOG_FILES / CLOCK_PERIOD filled in for whichever module is under evolution -- do not edit PLACEHOLDER_* fields by hand, they are overwritten.
_clock_note: picorv32_alu (and alu_basic) are purely combinational -- no CLOCK_PORT. OpenLane synthesizes/places/routes a clockless block fine; CLOCK_PERIOD still needs a nominal value because some internal STA/TritonCTS steps expect one, but it does not gate a real flop-to-flop path here. For a sequential module (e.g. counter_4bit), set CLOCK_PORT to the clk pin name and CLOCK_PERIOD to the real target period in ns.
